artifact.metric_ref: handoff_minutes (charter C1: average order-to-handoff time, weekday 7:00-10:00 peak)
artifact.notes: The alarm system for the improved process, set up the morning after the round-2 window closed. Selector: handoff minutes are continuous measurements, so the printed path lands on I-MR -- individual sampled orders in true collection order, the same shape the Measure baseline charted. Limits frozen 2026-09-22 from the round-2 pilot window (after-round2.csv, n=120): the freeze floor asks >=20 points with no rule-1/rule-4 signal in the window, and this window clears it at 120 points, zero signals, engine-verified before freezing (improve-run.md records the /stats/baseline run). Frozen band: center 4.899, individuals limits 3.029 / 6.770, MR UCL 2.298 -- computed by the engine from the window, never typed. The customer's 5.0-minute line is a SPEC limit and stays off this chart entirely: control limits say what the process is doing (centered 4.9, wobbling about 0.62 within-sigma), the spec line says what the customer needs, and 'out of control' and 'out of spec' stay different sentences -- this process is in control AND about 44% of its orders are out of spec, both true at once (the capability read in proof-round2). Armed at freeze: Priya enters each morning's 12 sampled orders at close of peak, signals checked at entry against the FROZEN band -- new points are judged by the limits, they do not reshape them; recalculation only ever happens as a deliberate, logged decision (e.g. a further proven process change moving the center for good). Armed and quiet since: zero signals through 2026-10-09 (the two weekly check-ins in coffee-control-plan score their entries against this frozen band).

assumptions_checked: baseline limits are frozen -- not recomputed from the current data
provenance.method: signals = WECO rule1 (imr: beyond the frozen +/-3sigma band; p: beyond each point's own frozen-pbar-derived limits) + rule4 (8 consecutive points same side of the frozen center) always, + rule2 (2 of 3 beyond 2 sigma)/rule3 (4 of 5 beyond 1 sigma) when opted in (I-MR only) -- evaluated against the FROZEN baseline over the current data (matrix §4a / VI.A.1)
